name: nougen-builds
description: Light-first contractor system. Navy carries trust, orange carries action, and the two are never asked to do each other's job.

provenance.observed: Brand and surface colors, radii, the three tinted shadows, the shared transition, font wiring, max-width and scroll offset, all measured from shipped CSS. The --on-accent, --accent-text and --accent-light pairings are now shipped on the live site as well.
provenance.invented: Spacing ramp, type scale, weights, tracking, the focus ring, ink-on-fill tokens, the darkened accent-text step, and the darkened text-muted replacement.

openWork: The variable --font-outfit loads Space Grotesk, not Outfit. Name kept for compatibility with existing markup.
Light-only by design. The dark hero, CTA band and footer are inverted sections, not a dark theme.
